description: Ground-truth manifest of deliberately injected bugs in the support_demo package. Used to score diagnostic accuracy of the automated technical-support system (COMP5200M MSc dissertation). Each bug maps to a related ticket category and a specific file/function.

bugs.title: Login crashes on empty password
bugs.bug_description: check_password_hash is called without first validating that the submitted password is non-empty, causing a NoneType/TypeError on empty input.
bugs.correct_fix: Add a guard that returns a 400 validation response when password is empty before calling check_password_hash.

bugs.title: Off-by-one error in page count
bugs.bug_description: Floor division undercounts pages by one when total_items is not an exact multiple of per_page.

bugs.title: JSON response missing Content-Type header
bugs.bug_description: The response omits the Content-Type: application/json header, so clients may misparse the body.
bugs.correct_fix: Set the Content-Type header to application/json on the response.

bugs.title: Unicode filenames cause upload failure
bugs.bug_description: The filename is encoded as ASCII, raising UnicodeEncodeError for non-ASCII filenames.
bugs.correct_fix: Encode the filename as UTF-8 (or use a safe filename helper) instead of ASCII.

bugs.title: Division by zero in average rating
bugs.bug_description: No guard against a zero rating_count, causing ZeroDivisionError for unrated products.
bugs.correct_fix: Return 0.0 when rating_count is zero before dividing.

bugs.title: Incorrect date format in CSV export
bugs.bug_description: Dates are formatted as US MM/DD/YYYY instead of ISO YYYY-MM-DD, breaking downstream imports.

bugs.title: Memory leak in thumbnail cache
bugs.bug_description: The cache has no size limit or eviction policy, so it grows without bound.
bugs.correct_fix: Introduce a maximum size with an eviction policy (e.g. an LRU cache).

bugs.title: Broken redirect after form submission
bugs.bug_description: Redirects to a non-existent endpoint name, producing a 404.

bugs.title: Race condition in counter increment
bugs.bug_description: A non-atomic read-modify-write loses updates under concurrency.
bugs.correct_fix: Use an atomic SQL UPDATE ... SET count = count + 1.

bugs.title: Duplicate emails sent on retry
bugs.bug_description: Retries without an idempotency check, so a slow-but-successful send is re-sent, producing duplicates.
bugs.correct_fix: Track a delivery/idempotency key and do not resend a delivered message.

bugs.title: Float rounding error in invoice totals
bugs.bug_description: Monetary values are accumulated as floats without rounding, producing precision errors.
bugs.correct_fix: Use Decimal for money or round to two decimal places.

bugs.title: Boolean flag inverted in feature toggle
bugs.bug_description: An erroneous negation inverts the feature flag, enabling disabled features and vice versa.
bugs.correct_fix: Remove the erroneous 'not'; return the flag value directly.

bugs.title: List index out of range in report builder
bugs.bug_description: Accesses rows[0] and rows[-1] without checking for an empty list, raising IndexError.
bugs.correct_fix: Return (None, None) when the input list is empty.

bugs.title: Infinite loop in retry backoff
bugs.bug_description: The attempt counter is never incremented, so a persistently failing operation loops forever.
bugs.correct_fix: Increment the attempts counter inside the loop body.

bugs.title: Header injection via unvalidated redirect
bugs.bug_description: target_url is used in the Location header without validation, allowing open-redirect and header injection.
bugs.correct_fix: Validate target_url against an allowlist and reject external/control characters.
